children: Egyptian developer Mountain View has started delivering the first phase of its 127-feddan Mountain View 1.1 project in New Cairo, while launching the development’s ready-to-move second phase.
The milestone follows around three-and-a-half years of construction and development work, the company said in a press statement on Thursday.
Mountain View 1.1 comprises more than 1,700 residential units across two main components: The Park, which includes iVillas and Millennials, and The Villas, comprising standalone villas.
The development also includes commercial and recreational facilities, green spaces, sports amenities and other services.
Mountain View 1.1 forms part of the developer’s ‘Signature Living’ portfolio and builds on Mountain View 1, its first residential development in East Cairo.
The wider portfolio includes Mountain View 1, Mountain View 2 and Mountain View 3 in East Cairo, Mountain View 4 in West Cairo and LVLS on the North Coast.
(Writing by Eman Hamed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
